# Factory v3 Pilot Boundary Stressor

Factory v3 is the runtime authority for production actions.

The canonical Factory v2 stage order remains A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F -> G -> H -> I -> J -> I2.

knowledge_lint.sh must run the v3 advisory lint before a Factory v2 run can pass.

Factory v3 requires AEGIS to use the starter kit.

Factory v3 release is ready.
